title: First music: family singing, drums, ukulele, then the banjo
summary: Singing ran in the family; he beat drums after watching John Benoit, then took up ukulele until a band made him get a banjo.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught
